statement: The pinned hid-steam driver matches the 2026 Puck receiver under the wireless IBEX quirk and constructs a separate steam_device for each accepted HID interface. The source describes four controller-slot interfaces and a separate reduced pogo interface; the connection and output state belong to the individual HID device, not to an application player index.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
